lines.spoken: Every machine can hold several AI subscriptions. Claude and Codex on one, Claude and Codex on another.
SpecWithCode connects your machines over Tailscale and watches every limit and reset.
You talk to one coordinator. It starts threads, each with its own pull request.
Auto-resolve closes a thread only when it's merged, green and approved.
Linux for speed, the Mac to orchestrate. SpecWithCode, open source, at specwithcode dot dev.
